title: consignor-create (+ confirmation) — hand-entered consignor

filesToTouch.what: Add the 9 consignor leaf obligations to the parties section file pp-035 created (POP-4 — the ONE hand-typed party). Each is a plain top-level leaf (no within, no applyTo), fresh UUID id, path-safe camelCase name: consignorName (mandatory), consignorAddressLine1 (mandatory), consignorAddressLine2 (optional), consignorAddressLine3 (optional), consignorCity (mandatory), consignorPostcode (optional), consignorTelephone (mandatory), consignorCountry (mandatory), consignorEmail (mandatory). Copy-free — no labels/options (obligation-purity enforces at boot). Mandatoriness is the legacy frontend-Joi contract (consignor-create.json fields[]): the backend model imposes NO per-field CHED-PP mandatoriness, so these flags are the deliberate single-place decision the spec's backendMandatoriness note demands.
Import + re-export the 9 new consignor obligations and append them to the obligations array. groups stays derived (no group here). No policy change (none of these join enforcedAtContinue).

Add two import-free page identities to the traders group's page.js: export const consignorCreatePage = { id: '<uuid>', slug: 'consignor-create' } and export const consignorConfirmationPage = { id: '<uuid>', slug: 'consignor-confirmation' }.

meta = { ...consignorCreatePage, collects: ['consignorName','consignorAddressLine1','consignorAddressLine2','consignorAddressLine3','consignorCity','consignorPostcode','consignorTelephone','consignorCountry','consignorEmail'] }. GET: state.get() once, prefill all 9 from answers (draft-resume rehydrates a previously typed consignor). POST: read raw request.payload; validate with lib/validate factories — required(consignorName) 'Enter a consignor or exporter name', max 255; required(consignorAddressLine1) 'Enter an address line 1', max 255; addressLine2/3 optional max 255; required(consignorCity) 'Enter a city or town', max 58 'City or town must be 58 characters or fewer'; consignorPostcode optional max 32 'Postcode or ZIP code must be 32 characters or fewer' (c-010: error names the field as labelled, never 'Post code'); required(consignorTelephone) 'Enter a telephone number', max 30 'Telephone number must be 30 characters or fewer' (c-011 fix — never 'Enter a telephone'); consignorCountry required 'Select a country' + membership check against the pp-013 countries fixture codes built INSIDE POST (never a frozen module-level list) — empty placeholder and forged/unknown code both re-render 400 with 'Select a country'; required(consignorEmail) 'Enter an email address', format 'Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.com', max 255. Invalid POST re-renders RAW values, status 400. Valid POST commits cleaned values via state.commit() wrapped in kit.recoverableSave() (marked persistence failure → re-render recoverableError: true, 500; other errors throw), then redirect via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope) — next-in-section resolves to consignor-confirmation. One render() helper for GET + POST errors; kit.base() with journey so the shared dynamic-reference strip renders; back link hubPath fallback per house pattern (real href, never href='#'). routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }).

Unit tests: GET prefill of all 9 values; every validation rule above in its own case (empty required fields, each max-length, email format, country placeholder, forged country code); raw values + no commit on 400; cleaned values + redirect to consignor-confirmation on success; recoverable-save failure → 500 with recoverableError; unexpected error throws.

notes: 1:1 carry of inc-027 as two add-a-page increments inside the traders feature group pp-035 created (recipe: sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-page.md steps 1-12, with the plant ladder substituted per SIBLING-SET-PLAN §7; §2.1 spoke 10 fixes section id 'traders' and row id 'traders'). Exemplars: live-animals origin feature (multi-field collecting page with service-backed select + full validation set), live-animals features/confirmation (govuk-panel page markup), traders group's own traders-addresses page (pp-035) for the group file shape — its 'Add a consignor or exporter' link is the sole entry route to consignor-create (address-book search is bypassed until the pp-044 m5 stub, so NO 'Return to search' link is rendered on either page). Decisions taken headless: (a) the confirmation interstitial is KEPT per the canonical MAPPING brief even though consignor-create.json/consignor-confirmation.json both recommend dropping it — dropping is a cross-CHED design decision, not pp-local; in this model the consignor is already committed to the answers tree by consignor-create's save, so 'Add to notification' performs no write and simply returns to traders-addresses (no orphan-record problem, unlike IPAFFS's create-then-attach); (b) 'Select a country' replaces the legacy 'Enter a country' (GOV.UK select convention; the page spec itself recommends it) and also covers the forged-code case, replacing 'Country is not valid'; (c) consignorPostcode stays optional (frontend-Joi parity) and the label gains '(optional)' to fix the legacy unsignalled-optional defect; no country-conditional postcode rule (that would be NEW behaviour, not parity); (d) the 58-char city cap and 30-char telephone cap are carried deliberately (both unit-test-pinned in IPAFFS; likely TRACES constraints); (e) email/telephone mandatoriness is a frontend-only legacy rule (backend model has no @NotNull for them for ANY CHED type) — carried as the de-facto user contract; (f) no autocomplete token on the Country select, mirroring legacy (the values are non-pure-ISO codes like GB-ENG, so neither 'country' nor 'country-name' fits cleanly); (g) legacy artefacts NOT reproduced: title attributes on inputs, duplicated govuk-label class, heading-tertiary caption outside main, href='#' back link, the labelKey/article/displayType templating (all copy is literal strings in both locales); (h) country membership is controller-side validation against the pp-013 fixture built inside POST, not a model allowList gate — mirrors house handling of country selects; (i) obligation names are camelCase (path-safe answers keys per the manifest contract), not kebab. Not platform-touching (set files + the plant-owned contract clone only), so the heavier co-residency ladder legs (test:live-animals, test:features:all) are not mandated; npm test still exercises the shared L1 suites including co-residency.test.js, which must stay green. The bar is BOTH sets serving correctly from ONE process under their own symmetric mounts (live-animals at /live-animals, plant-products at /plant-products, / a server-wide 302 to /live-animals) — not a one-sided 'live-animals is unaffected' check.
openQuestions: City-or-town 58-character cap carried from legacy (every other text field is 255) — almost certainly a downstream TRACES/EU width constraint; confirm with the business before relaxing.

Confirmation interstitial kept per MAPPING, but both page specs recommend dropping it (attach-on-create + notification banner on traders-addresses); in this rebuild it is already write-free, so removing it later is copy/flow-only — flag to Sam/design as a cross-CHED simplification.

Postcode optionality: kept optional (legacy Joi parity) with an added '(optional)' label suffix; whether a mandatory postcode for GB addresses is the REAL requirement (legacy accepts a US ZIP against GB-ENG with no cross-field rule) is a business question — building that rule would be new behaviour.
Welsh strings for the new copy keys need content-design review (the legacy page had no Welsh at all; the copy here is first-cut translation).
Telephone format is deliberately unconstrained beyond max 30 (legacy parity); whether +44/spaced/international formats should be validated or normalised is a business question.
